subject: FARS-1/FARSA: A tRNA Synthetase That Silences Mitochondrial dsRNAs to Extend Lifespan
script: From Agewell Brief: FARS-1/FARSA: A tRNA Synthetase That Silences Mitochondrial dsRNAs to Extend Lifespan. A moonlighting enzyme suppresses immunogenic mitochondrial double-stranded RNAs, balancing longevity and innate immunity in worms and human cells. Mitochondrial dsRNAs accumulate with age and trigger aberrant immune activation. FARS-1/FARSA binds dsRNAs via a novel domain, reducing their levels. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
